snippet.title: Schrodinger's Cat Burglar - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Schrodinger's Cat Burglar on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111550/Schrodingers_Cat_Burglar/

Schrodinger's Cat Burglar is an upcoming indie puzzle adventure game with a quantum feline twist. Solve mind-bending puzzle rooms as one cat in two places at once. When world famous cat burglar Mittens is on a heist that goes belly up, she finds herself with the ability to split into two quantum superpositions. She must use her new powers to uncover dirty corporate secrets, escape from the facility, complete her mission and return home for a well-deserved cat nap. Play the campaign solo or in local co-op multiplayer with a friend or partner! Wishlist Schrodinger's Cat Burglar on Steam to be notified when it releases, and play the free game demo right meow.

Developed by Abandoned Sheep
https://abandonedsheep.com/
